flowRoot.flowPara: git submodules provide "standard" mechanism for modular composition and on demand installation or uninstallation. DataLad can help manage submodules.
Required (3rd-party) code repositories can be referenced as subdatasets just like datasets with data files. Repository state is unambiguous version record.

flowRoot.flowPara: Get more infos on STAMPED principles and the paper

An increasing number of public data is shared via tracked version controlled and distributable datasets with flexible on demand accessibility to their elements. Where needed flexible authentication mechanisms are deployed.

flowRoot.flowPara: Subdataset references in a dataset are extremely lightweight yet guarantee data identity via cryptographic hashes.
Subdatasets can be detached without losing this information, yielding massively improved storage efficiency and reduced archive costs.

text.tspan: Tracked: state and provenance of all components are recorded
Actionable: machine-actionable informaion to obtain or reproduce content
Portable: retains STAMPED properties across environments
Ephemeral: procedures execute in throwaway environments
Distributable: all modules shareable externally in a persistent state
